description: 统一 Teamwork 输入分层与结构化结果，修复单次调用终态与诊断
changelog: Role initialization and mode-specific result contracts are separated from task/reference data. New content reports use schema 2; run, batch and wait provide a normalized machine result. Historical frozen reports remain readable. Tool permissions automatically allow; Codex defaults to no sandbox. Input preflight, supervisor failures, failed-attempt identity, report artifacts and diagnostics are verified.
notes: Run trellis update to refresh Teamwork role cards and Skill references. Agents must request --json; default human/event views remain available. Content shape validation does not perform main-agent semantic acceptance. Existing frozen launches retain their report contract.
